Riley (Support): Escalating — OrionHealth onboarding demo hitting intermittent embedding 504s and tail latency spikes. Renewal review in 5 days. Ticket #498122.
Nora (CS Ops): Acknowledged. Which deployment and model? I can draft a short comms note and coordinate.
Riley (Support): Dedicated EU pool, model embed-med-quant. Errors on /v1/embeddings/batch-upsert around their demo windows. Sample log: `TS=2026-03-21T11:42Z REQ=b3f9 route=/v1/embeddings status=504 latency=1820ms err=kv-cache-evict`.
Dev (CSM): I'll own customer comms and the enablement. Propose: immediate ack + 2h ETA, temporary routing to embed-med-stable during demo, 500 free embed units, 30-min tech session. Alex — confirm renewal timing?
Alex (AE): Renewal call Monday 09:00 CET. Prefer to avoid systemic credits; goodwill credit OK if we show clear engineering plan. I'll join the enablement.
alert-bot: INC-498122 created 1: assignee eng-runtime, priority=P1.
Hana (eng-runtime): Quick triage — looks like aggressive batching merging requests with large shared prefixes causing KV churn. Short-term: enable tenant_single_batch and route demo traffic to embed-med-stable. I can flip flags now for a 3-hour window. Need a representative failed request payload.
Riley (Support): Sample prompt (redacted): "normalize patient intake and map to SNOMED codes..." failed at 2026-03-21T11:42:15Z. Autoscale is fixed dedicated pool. Traces attached to INC-498122.
Nora (CS Ops): Action items: Hana to apply mitigation (owner) and monitor; Dev to send ack + schedule enablement; Alex to prep renewal note based on status; Riley to attach traces and keep customer informed.
Dev (CSM): Sent ack to customer offering mitigation and 500 embed units credit. Scheduling enablement for today 15:00 UTC.
Hana (eng-runtime): Mitigation applied: tenant_single_batch=true and demo routes routed to embed-med-stable. Early metrics: tail 99p latency reduced from 1.8s -> 140ms. Monitoring for 30m.
Riley (Support): Customer confirms demo success under mitigation and appreciates the quick response.
Nora (CS Ops): Great. We'll reconvene after enablement to finalize postmortem and a short status email for Alex's renewal call. Thanks team.
